summary: Recorded a branch of the verify path the existing account leaves implicit: VerifyLeader answers success immediately, with no peer contact and no heartbeat, whenever the configuration's voter quorum size is one, which bounds the non-voter acknowledgement defect to quorums larger than one and is the only VerifyLeader success decided purely from local state. Added a source anchor for the fast path (raft.go 966-980) and a behavior knowledge entry citing it together with the three anchors the verify account already uses. Validation returned valid with those two effects and no execution requested; the open items for the store-failure account - a live leader's retry sequence, the vote claim of a damaged node, and the restart-hides-the-hole consequence - remain as recorded.
